name: ClickAndCollectOrderConsole
tagline: Pick, stage, notify, hand over and chase uncollected orders – a complete buy-online-pick-up-in-store (BOPIS) console for Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A full click & collect module in one PCF control: Today dashboard with late, at-risk and uncollected orders, a pick queue sorted by the promised pickup time, pick & stage with short-pick handling and staging locations by temperature zone, customer notification with a collection code, a hand-over desk with code, ID and payment checks, a status board, a shelf map of every staging location and a full order list with bulk actions.
features: Promised pickup with Late and At-risk states and a per-hour promise chart
Max active picks per associate, release and back-to-picking
Per-line picked quantities, short / substitution note required when short
Staging locations as simple text (A01..A16=Ambient;C01..C06=Chilled) with zone rules
Chilled / frozen orders only in cold locations, lockers only for prepaid orders without 18+ items, one order per location
Notification template with {first}, {order}, {code}, {holdUntil} – message, recipient and channel as outputs for your flow
Hand-over desk: search by order, name, phone or code; code check, photo-ID check for age-restricted items, payment for pay-on-collection
Hold period, reminders (max 3), hold expired → uncollected → return to stock with restock confirmation
Cold-chain warning for chilled orders waiting too long
Board and shelf map with live occupancy, on-time % and order-to-ready time, CSV export, undo, keyboard shortcuts, phone layout
tags: buy online pick up in store
